# DataCamp Campus

> > DataCamp Campus offers interactive courses in data science, visualization, and NLP with hands-on Python and R exercises.

DataCamp Campus is an online learning platform providing structured courses in data science, business analytics, and machine learning. The platform features interactive exercises, real-world datasets, and practical instruction across Python, R, Excel, and specialized libraries like Bokeh and spaCy.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Data Visualization
- Bokeh
- spaCy NLP
- Natural Language Processing
- Data Privacy
- Interactive Learning
- Entity Recognition
- Fraud Detection
- Excel Data Transformation
- Scatter Plots
- Rule-Based Matching
- Statistical Analysis
- Data Fundamentals

## Natural Language Processing

- [Combining models and rules | Python](https://campus.datacamp.com/courses/advanced-nlp-with-spacy/large-scale-data-analysis-with-spacy?ex=11): Advanced spaCy NLP exercise on combining statistical models with rules

## Data Visualization

- [Blocks vs. rebounds | Python](https://campus.datacamp.com/courses/interactive-data-visualization-with-bokeh/introduction-to-bokeh?ex=3): Bokeh scatter plot exercise with NBA basketball data visualization
- [Communicating with text | Python](https://campus.datacamp.com/courses/interactive-data-visualization-with-bokeh/storytelling-with-visualizations?ex=10): Bokeh data storytelling exercise on text communication and visualization

## Data Fundamentals & Privacy

- [Privacy concerns | Theory](https://campus.datacamp.com/courses/introduction-to-data/data-in-depth?ex=4): Introduction to Data course exercise on data privacy fundamentals

## Data Preparation & Analysis

- [Referencing and summarization | Excel](https://campus.datacamp.com/courses/data-preparation-in-excel/lookups-and-data-transformation?ex=3): Excel data transformation exercise using HLOOKUP and Pivot Tables
- [Multivariate outlier detection | R](https://campus.datacamp.com/courses/fraud-detection-in-r/digit-analysis-and-robust-statistics?ex=12): Fraud detection in R course exercise on multivariate outlier detection
